title: Old-school classifiers are still generally better than Jev [P]
summary: There’s a lot of hype right now around decision models like Jev. But in most real use cases, you have some labeled data, and can use it to personalize your model. So we tested the old-school approach to classification and regression: Embed your inputs with an open-source or cheap
